sentence: How do you cope with stress at work?
zh-TW: 你怎麼應對工作上的壓力？

sentence: The flight takes approximately three hours.
zh-TW: 這班飛機大約要飛三個小時。

sentence: We still need to book accommodation for the trip.
zh-TW: 我們還需要訂這趟旅行的住宿。
tagging_notes: book 在此為動詞「預訂」

sentence: The highlight of our trip was the night market.
zh-TW: 這趟旅行的亮點是夜市。
tagging_notes: highlight 在此為名詞「最精彩的部分」，與詞表解釋「強調」不同

sentence: A reporter asked me a few questions on the street.
zh-TW: 有位記者在街上問了我幾個問題。

sentence: I'm not used to the climate here yet.
zh-TW: 我還不習慣這裡的氣候。

sentence: This shirt is too small for me.
zh-TW: 這件襯衫我穿太小了。

sentence: Everyone has to pay, with no exception.
zh-TW: 每個人都要付錢，沒有例外。

sentence: She works for a large corporation in the city.
zh-TW: 她在市區一家大公司上班。

sentence: This phone has a faster chip.
zh-TW: 這支手機的晶片比較快。

sentence: The winner will get a free trip.
zh-TW: 得獎者會獲得一趟免費旅行。

sentence: We encountered a few problems on the way.
zh-TW: 我們在路上遇到了一些問題。

sentence: I'm looking for brown shoes.
zh-TW: 我在找棕色的鞋子。

sentence: Take a deep breath and breathe slowly.
zh-TW: 深吸一口氣，然後慢慢呼吸。

sentence: That's not a good excuse for being late.
zh-TW: 那不是遲到的好藉口。
tagging_notes: excuse 在此為名詞「藉口」

sentence: It was partly my fault.
zh-TW: 這有一部分是我的錯。

sentence: Do you want to play tennis this weekend?
zh-TW: 這週末要不要去打網球？

sentence: Urban life can be very stressful.
zh-TW: 都市生活可能壓力很大。

sentence: These two buttons always confuse me.
zh-TW: 這兩個按鈕總是讓我搞混。

sentence: It's warmer in the southern part of the island.
zh-TW: 島的南部比較暖和。

sentence: Our team's output has doubled this year.
zh-TW: 我們團隊今年的產出增加了一倍。
tagging_notes: output 在此為「產出、產量」

sentence: The beauty of this place is its quiet.
zh-TW: 這個地方的美在於它的寧靜。

sentence: There was a massive line outside the store.
zh-TW: 店外排了一條超長的隊。

sentence: I need to install this app first.
zh-TW: 我得先安裝這個應用程式。

sentence: Can you calculate how much we each owe?
zh-TW: 你可以算一下我們每個人要付多少嗎？

sentence: My computer mouse stopped working.
zh-TW: 我的電腦滑鼠壞了。

sentence: Mathematics was my favorite subject at school.
zh-TW: 數學是我在學校最喜歡的科目。

sentence: Please put your bag in the upper compartment.
zh-TW: 請把包包放在上方的置物櫃。

sentence: This dish is the chef's own creation.
zh-TW: 這道菜是主廚自己的創作。

sentence: Is this seat occupied?
zh-TW: 這個位子有人坐嗎？
tagging_notes: occupy 在此為「佔用（座位）」，非「佔領」

sentence: Can you send me a short outline of the plan?
zh-TW: 你可以寄給我計畫的簡短大綱嗎？

sentence: Two days should be sufficient to see the city.
zh-TW: 兩天應該足夠逛完這座城市。

sentence: Please update the app to the latest version.
zh-TW: 請把應用程式更新到最新版本。

sentence: Good luck with your exam tomorrow!
zh-TW: 祝你明天考試順利！

sentence: Salt helps preserve the meat.
zh-TW: 鹽有助於保存肉類。

sentence: Let's split the bill.
zh-TW: 我們分攤帳單吧。
tagging_notes: split 在此為「分攤」

sentence: The kids are playing on the swings.
zh-TW: 孩子們在盪鞦韆。
tagging_notes: swing 在此為名詞「鞦韆」，與詞表解釋「擺動」相關

sentence: He missed a week of work because of illness.
zh-TW: 他因為生病請了一個星期的假。

sentence: My sister is a journalist for a local paper.
zh-TW: 我姊姊是地方報紙的記者。

sentence: There was a sudden change in the weather.
zh-TW: 天氣突然變了。

sentence: I saw an advertisement for this sale online.
zh-TW: 我在網路上看到這個特賣的廣告。

sentence: Try to be consistent with your study time.
zh-TW: 讀書時間盡量要固定。
tagging_notes: consistent 在此為「一致的、持續穩定的」

sentence: I'm originally from a small town.
zh-TW: 我原本是從一個小鎮來的。

sentence: Can you put this aside for me?
zh-TW: 你可以幫我把這個留起來嗎？
tagging_notes: put aside 在此為「保留、留著」

sentence: She tried to comfort her crying friend.
zh-TW: 她試著安慰她哭泣的朋友。
tagging_notes: comfort 在此為動詞「安慰」，與詞表解釋「舒適」不同

sentence: Firstly, it's cheap. Secondly, it's close.
zh-TW: 第一，它很便宜。第二，它很近。

sentence: She has a severe headache.
zh-TW: 她頭痛得很厲害。

sentence: Eye color is passed down through genes.
zh-TW: 眼睛的顏色是透過基因遺傳的。

sentence: The job has good prospects.
zh-TW: 這份工作很有前景。

sentence: It snowed all night.
zh-TW: 雪下了一整夜。
tagging_notes: snow 在此為動詞「下雪」

sentence: The movie has a really interesting plot.
zh-TW: 這部電影的情節很有趣。

sentence: My neck hurts from sleeping wrong.
zh-TW: 我睡姿不對，脖子很痛。

sentence: What are the criteria for this scholarship?
zh-TW: 這個獎學金的申請標準是什麼？

sentence: The course is primarily for beginners.
zh-TW: 這門課主要是給初學者的。

sentence: The new system is easy to integrate with our software.
zh-TW: 新系統很容易和我們的軟體整合。

sentence: He doesn't handle criticism very well.
zh-TW: 他不太能接受批評。

sentence: There's a big convention in town this week.
zh-TW: 這週鎮上有一場大型會議。
tagging_notes: convention 在此為「大型會議、大會」，與詞表解釋「慣例」不同

sentence: I bet you'll love this place.
zh-TW: 我敢說你一定會愛上這個地方。
tagging_notes: bet 在此為口語「敢說、肯定」

sentence: Please retain your receipt.
zh-TW: 請保留您的收據。

sentence: Put the pictures in the right sequence.
zh-TW: 把這些圖片按正確的順序排好。
tagging_notes: sequence 在此為「順序」

sentence: I'd like a plain T-shirt with no logo.
zh-TW: 我想要一件沒有圖案的素色 T 恤。
tagging_notes: plain 在此為形容詞「素的、樸素的」，與詞表解釋「平原」不同

sentence: She volunteers at the animal shelter.
zh-TW: 她在動物收容所當志工。
tagging_notes: volunteer 在此為動詞「當志工」

sentence: They moved to a quiet rural area.
zh-TW: 他們搬到一個安靜的鄉下地方。

sentence: Please stay calm and wait here.
zh-TW: 請保持冷靜，在這裡等候。

sentence: We had to abandon our plans because of the rain.
zh-TW: 因為下雨，我們只好放棄原本的計畫。

sentence: The doctor will do a quick examination.
zh-TW: 醫生會做個簡單的檢查。
tagging_notes: examination 在此為「（身體）檢查」，與詞表解釋「考試」不同

sentence: There was an awkward silence after he spoke.
zh-TW: 他說完後出現一陣尷尬的沉默。

sentence: Prices are rising rapidly.
zh-TW: 物價正在快速上漲。

sentence: This new heater is very efficient.
zh-TW: 這台新的暖氣機很有效率。

sentence: Smartphones started a revolution in how we talk.
zh-TW: 智慧型手機掀起了我們溝通方式的革命。

sentence: To my delight, the shop was still open.
zh-TW: 讓我高興的是，那家店還開著。

sentence: How do you spell your last name?
zh-TW: 你的姓怎麼拼？

sentence: The movie's premise is simple but clever.
zh-TW: 這部電影的前提設定簡單又巧妙。

sentence: Don't lean against the door.
zh-TW: 請勿倚靠車門。
tagging_notes: lean 在此為「倚靠」

sentence: There was a dramatic drop in sales.
zh-TW: 銷售額大幅下滑。
tagging_notes: dramatic 在此為「劇烈的、大幅的」

sentence: Prices differ from store to store.
zh-TW: 每家店的價格都不一樣。

sentence: I'm really grateful for your help.
zh-TW: 我真的很感謝你的幫忙。

sentence: Eggs are a good source of protein.
zh-TW: 蛋是很好的蛋白質來源。

sentence: I ride my bike to work.
zh-TW: 我騎腳踏車上班。

sentence: We'll distribute the flyers this afternoon.
zh-TW: 我們今天下午會發傳單。

sentence: He enjoys intellectual conversations.
zh-TW: 他喜歡有深度的知性對話。

sentence: Many English words are derived from Latin.
zh-TW: 很多英文單字源自拉丁文。
tagging_notes: derive from 在此為「源自」

sentence: Sleep is crucial for good health.
zh-TW: 睡眠對健康至關重要。

sentence: Unemployment went down last year.
zh-TW: 去年的失業率下降了。

sentence: One of the wheels on my suitcase is broken.
zh-TW: 我行李箱的一個輪子壞了。

sentence: The rain was good for the crops this year.
zh-TW: 今年的雨水對農作物很有幫助。

sentence: Only a minority of students passed the test.
zh-TW: 只有少數學生通過了考試。

sentence: What's the origin of this tradition?
zh-TW: 這個傳統的起源是什麼？

sentence: That's an interesting interpretation of the story.
zh-TW: 那是對這個故事很有意思的解讀。

sentence: The gentleman by the window is waiting for you.
zh-TW: 窗邊那位先生在等你。

sentence: I've been watching a Korean drama lately.
zh-TW: 我最近在看一部韓劇。
tagging_notes: drama 在此為「影集」

sentence: The landscape here is breathtaking.
zh-TW: 這裡的風景美得令人屏息。

sentence: We need to educate kids about online safety.
zh-TW: 我們需要教育孩子網路安全的知識。

sentence: My son wants a new toy for his birthday.
zh-TW: 我兒子生日想要一個新玩具。

sentence: Don't worry, it's not your fault.
zh-TW: 別擔心，這不是你的錯。

sentence: The museum has a new photography exhibit.
zh-TW: 博物館有一個新的攝影展。
tagging_notes: exhibit 在此為名詞「展覽」

sentence: It's only a minor problem.
zh-TW: 這只是個小問題。

sentence: I spent the whole day hunting for a gift.
zh-TW: 我花了一整天找禮物。
tagging_notes: hunt 在此為口語「到處尋找」，與詞表解釋「狩獵」不同

sentence: The storm delayed our flight.
zh-TW: 暴風雨讓我們的班機延誤了。

sentence: It's cold, so wear a thick coat.
zh-TW: 天氣很冷，穿件厚外套吧。
